notes: One entry per P2ID address scheme, keyed by its domain (p2id.vault.vN). A scheme fixes every address: p2id = CREATE2(factory, identityHash, vaultInitCodeHash), with identityHash computed under identityDomain. Each Pvium environment is a separate stack with its own factory: `production` (mainnets) and `sandbox` (testnets); within an environment the factory has one address on every chain. The scheme domain is also the factory's namespace (nsHash = keccak256(domain)) and the deterministic-deployment salt. Entries are history: once any factory is recorded the entry is frozen, and a vault change means adding p2id.vault.v(N+1) and moving `current`; older schemes stay derivable forever. While no factory is recorded, `node scripts/embed-p2id.mjs --update` refreshes vaultInitCodeHash from the Hardhat artifact.
